stem.text: Which reagents and conditions would result in the formation of butanenitrile, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CN}$?

A.text: 1-bromobutane heated under pressure with ammonia in ethanol

B.text: 1-bromopropane heated with potassium cyanide in ethanol

C.text: propanal heated with hydrogen cyanide in the presence of potassium cyanide

D.text: propanone heated with hydrogen cyanide in the presence of potassium cyanide
